ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image is a schematic diagram of an anatomical section of the male pelvis; the arrow labeled 92 on the right points to an obliquely arranged striated muscle on the medial wall of the pelvis, near the obturator region. This location corresponds to one of the main muscles of the lateral wall of the pelvis. Judging from its anatomical position, this muscle is the obturator internus. Therefore, structure 92 is the obturator internus.
